topic: Updating ad data discrepancies for AFA
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reconciling discrepancies between existing production data and newly calculated analytics data (AFA) for the period 2026-01-24 to 2026-02-01. It was determined that updating only the three days with the largest discrepancies (2026-01-26 - 2026-01-28) would be sufficient, as this resolved the Total Traffic discrepancy.

After manually recalculating and updating the production data for the specified three days, the Total Traffic metric discrepancy was resolved. However, discrepancies in Impressions for other dates remain unexplained and were agreed to be ignored.
decisions: Update AFA production data only for 2026-01-26 through 2026-01-28.
action_items: Someone needs to confirm the specific date range (S3 to JCD) for data transfer, which includes 2026-01-22 and 2026-01-26 through 2026-01-28, plus an additional date of 2026-01-29.
